description: Source code for pathspec handling in a Git-like project, including functions for matching pathspecs against index entries, parsing pathspecs, and handling pathspec attributes and magic.

methods.name: add_pathspec_matches_against_index
methods.description: Matches given pathspecs against index entries, updating the seen array with match information.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_against_index
methods.description: Allocates and returns a seen array indicating closest matches of pathspecs against index.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_skip_worktree
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches in index, skipping worktree entries.

methods.name: pathspec_magic_names
methods.description: Generates a string listing the magic flags set in a pathspec.

methods.name: unsupported_magic
methods.description: Handles unsupported magic in pathspec patterns, producing an error.

methods.name: parse_pathspec
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a pathspec structure, handling magic and attributes.

methods.name: parse_pathspec_file
methods.description: Reads a file of pathspec patterns and parses into a pathspec structure.

methods.name: copy_pathspec
methods.description: Copies a pathspec structure, duplicating all contained data.

methods.name: clear_pathspec
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a pathspec structure.

methods.name: match_pathspec_attrs
methods.description: Checks if a file's attributes match the specified pathspec attributes.

methods.name: pathspec_needs_expanded_index
methods.description: Determines if the index needs to be expanded based on the pathspec patterns.
